confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence because resort-area menus are fairly predictable. Hostel anchors are low confidence because Punta Cana has few registered hostels, so the dorm and private-room figures are rough. Hotel anchors are medium-low because resort-area rates vary widely by property and season; July is shoulder season with hurricane-season risk, so these are not peak-season rates. FX NOT VERIFIED: web searches returned no confirmable RBA observation for the latest date. Results were third-party, undated, or older than the reference window, and the rba.gov.au results gave no readable rate content. The fx observation fields are therefore null. Do not convert AUD values from this record until a verified RBA observation is supplied. The official source is the RBA exchange rates table at https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Caribbean resort destinations with similar all-inclusive and beach-tourism price structures, such as Cancun/Playa del Carmen and Puerto Plata. Local food prices are benchmarked to the Dominican domestic market. Accommodation is benchmarked to the Bavaro/Punta Cana resort corridor, where visitors typically stay, and includes typical Dominican taxes and service charges.
